turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Sure! Watch me solve one first.
I write emails. My boss writes emails.
First: "my boss" is one person, so "he" or "she".
Second: add -s to "write": writes.
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: He writes every morning. Wrong: He write every morning.
Your turn now. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
